items.text: Shared tab shell — list tabs (Pages, Categories, Tags, Finders, Collections) now share the same intro copy, toolbar, filter field, and empty-state pattern. Backups, Stats, Theme, and Keyboard use the same semantic intros and spacing rhythm.
Classic surface cards (v4) — on the Classic layout, each list tab wraps its toolbar and list in one elevated .config-tab-surface card instead of separate floating blocks.
Intro spacing — consistent vertical gap between the tab intro paragraph and the content below on General, Bookmarks, and all list tabs (no more cramped toolbars flush against the intro text).
Button clipping — tab toolbars and action buttons no longer clip at the right edge; config chrome descendants use border-box sizing so padding stays inside the panel width.
Unified save status — one status line beside Save replaces the old separate unsaved badge. The sticky save bar hint stays in sync when you scroll.
Per-tab save mode pill — the breadcrumb row shows Requires save, Auto-save, or Read-only for the active tab (e.g. Categories auto-save vs General requires Save).
Empty-state CTAs — Tags and Collections empty states link to useful next steps (open Bookmarks to add a tag; start editing a collection) instead of leaving you on a blank panel.

Context panel — the former Structure workspace is now Context: a compact page/category switcher for the list below. Reorder, archive, templates, icons, and merge live on the Pages and Categories tabs — links in the panel footnote take you there.
Remember Context open/closed — collapsed or expanded state is stored in localStorage and restored when you return to Bookmarks.
Breadcrumb context — on Bookmarks and Categories, the breadcrumb trail shows the active page and category (e.g. config / bookmarks / Work / dev).
Phone deep link — opening /config#bookmarks on a phone shows a clear desktop only card with a link back to the dashboard instead of a broken empty editor.

Config → Help (EN / NL / DE / FR) — the in-app help index now documents tab shell consistency, breadcrumb save mode, the unified save status line, the Bookmarks Context panel, and the phone #bookmarks desktop-only card. The What's new recap at the top of Help includes this release.
User manual (MANUAL.md) — expanded config walkthrough: list tabs, save-mode pills, Config → Help section, Context vs Pages/Categories editing, and updated troubleshooting for the new save UX.
